question: How do I form a limited liability company, and what does it cost?

nuggets.text: Organizers sign and deliver articles of organization to the State Corporation Commission.
nuggets.quote: One or more persons may act as organizers of a limited liability company by signing and delivering articles of organization to the Commission for filing.

nuggets.text: The filing fee for articles of organization is $100.
nuggets.quote: For filing any one of the following, the fee shall be $100: a.

nuggets.text: The articles must set forth the required contents.
nuggets.quote: The articles of organization shall set forth: 1.

nuggets.text: The company must continuously maintain a registered office and registered agent in Virginia.
nuggets.quote: A registered office that may be the same as any of its places of business; and 2.

nuggets.text: An annual registration fee is due to the Commission each year.
